title: Why We Procrastinate, Explained
desc: Procrastination isn't laziness. It's one of the most human things we do. Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through why we put things off: an ancient habit, how common it really is, why it's about feelings, the mood-freezing pill, working under pressure, the stranger in the future, why everything takes longer, the power of deadlines, a tug of war in the brain, why we do things, the phone in your pocket, perfectionism, if-then plans, just starting, temptation bundling, better together, fresh starts, forgiving yourself, bedtime procrastination, wellbeing, good and bad delay, structured procrastination, habits, short breaks and 'consider it done'. We end with a gentle toolkit and a slow wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like.
